record.question: India had recently revoked the MFN (Most Favoured Nation) status which was given to Pakistan in 1996 due to ________ terror attack.
record.explanation: Answer B: Pulwama. India’s 2019 withdrawal of Pakistan’s MFN status followed the Pulwama terror attack; a World Bank regional trade analysis records the 2019 action in that context. Reference: https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/172151637224905060/pdf/Regional-Investment-Pioneers-in-South-Asia-The-Payoff-of-Knowing-Your-Neighbors.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
